issues: Sales were 42,220.35 against a 38,500 target, 3,720.35 (+9.66%) ahead, and 2,574.04 up week on week.
Year on year, spend per head fell to 19.47 from 24.04 (-19%) and covers fell to 1,809 from 2,636 (-31.37%).
The GM and HC notes put covers down 25 (-1.5%) and spend per head down 1.09 (-5.17%) week on week, missing the 23 pound SPH target.
Operational labour was 22.57% (9,618.68) against a 22% target, missed by 0.57%, with 653.35 hours used, partly due to the 5 pound ramen day.
The FOH and BOH labour split averaged 46.01% and 53.99% against a 45% and 55% target.
Drinks mix was 13.89%, sushi 17.33% and sides 15.62%, with drinks, sushi and sides all up but targets not hit.
Food variance was 1.8% and drinks variance 1.0%, both within the acceptable range, and food spend was 22% against a 25% target.
Chicken Ramen, Steak Tataki Ramen and Chicken Yakisoba were the top sellers.
The site received 9 Google reviews, 7 of them 4 or 5 star, and hit 95% on the review bonus measure.
Weekly hygiene compliance scored 96 against a 95 target, and pest control, fire, electrical, gas and ventilation checks are complete.
FOH urgently needs two more part time staff, with one candidate on a trial shift this Friday and a second being arranged.
A FOH team member walked out on Saturday and is being replaced.
Nico has left the BOH team, and Abi is fully onboarded on FOH.
Slerp preorders are hard to manage because they printed on arrival rather than at the requested time.
Mapal compliance and review volume are the stated areas for improvement.
The Maki Biru beer line does not work at all and an emergency light has gone out, both high priority.
Open medium priority jobs are the heat lamps, the Kobas printer, an overheating stock room and waiter stations 1 and 2 coming away from the wall.
The bar fridge is intermittently leaking, logged as low priority.
actions: Complete FOH part time trial shifts and replace the leaver - Owner: Joe Herrera (06/10/2026)
Improve Mapal compliance and review volume - Owner: Joe Herrera (06/10/2026)
